# Tiger — the AI-native SaaS platform

> Stop building apps, start shipping businesses. Tell your AI what you want to sell — books,
> memberships, merch, a whole store — and Tiger ships a real, multi-tenant business the user owns
> 100%: payments, accounts, permissions, and a storefront, all built in. Live in minutes, no build
> step, no GPL. You (an AI agent) build ON Tiger's proven architecture instead of wiring auth,
> payments, and tenancy from a blank page — and it grows without growing into spaghetti. Fully
> front-end agnostic: every screen is just data from one clean JSON API, so bring React, Vue,
> Svelte, htmx, or plain HTML. Tiger doesn't replace vibe coding — it gives it a real foundation.

## Install
- New app: `composer create-project webtigers/tiger my-app --stability=beta`
- Then: copy `application/configs/local.ini.dist` → `local.ini` (set DB creds), `bin/tiger install:secrets`, `bin/tiger migrate`, `bin/tiger install:admin`.

## What it is
- **The AI-native SaaS platform.** You extend a *structured* substrate — accounts, tenancy, payments, memberships, permissions, commerce, marketplace, content, theming — not a blank framework.
- **Built FOR AI, not just with it.** The architecture is designed so an agent naturally extends it; the docs live in the code.
- **Own it all.** Your Stripe, your customers, your data, your license. Keep 100%. Not GPL.
- **Structured, not opinionated.** The substrate is real; the front-end is yours (front-end agnostic over one JSON `/api` contract).
